ingredients: 12 oz (350g) smoked haddock fillet (finnan haddie); 8 large eggs, separated; 1/2 cup half and half; 4 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan; Freshly ground black pepper; 4 tbsp butter

When foaming, add the egg mixture. 13. Cook, lifting up the sides of the omelet as they set with a rubber spatula, allowing the uncooked egg mixture to run underneath the cooked portion, about 3 minutes, or until the omelet is almost set but the top is uncooked. 14. Sprinkle the remaining 2 tbsp of Parmesan over the omelet. 15. Pour the remaining half-and-half over the top. 16. Broil until the top of the omelet is set and lightly browned. 17. Serve immediately, straight from the pan.

title: Sesame Garlic Broccoli S-C-J
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sesame seeds; 20 ounces broccoli (1 1/4 lbs); 2 fresh garlic cloves, chopped fine; 3 teaspoons sesame oil; 1 tablespoon chili sauce (or your favorite hot sauce); 3 teaspoons light soy sauce
directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Spread the sesame seeds in a single layer on a cookie sheet. 3. Bake in the oven for 12 minutes until fragrant and golden brown. 4. When done, remove from hot pan into medium bowl to stop cooking. 5. Mix the chopped garlic, sesame oil, chili sauce, and soy sauce. 6. Using a vegetable peeler, peel the stalks of broccoli. 7. Quarter the broccoli stalks lengthwise. 8. Steam the broccoli in a vegetable steamer over water until it reaches desired tenderness. 9. *If you like broccoli a little crunchy, steam for about 2 minutes. 10. Remove broccoli and place in serving bowl. 11. Drizzle the sauce over it and mix well. 12. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds. 13. TIP: 14. This vegetable dish keeps well and is delicious cold. Keep it airtight in your refrigerator.

title: Beef And Broccoli Recipe
ingredients: 2/3 c. A.1. Original Steak Sauce; 1/3 c. soy sauce; 2 x cloves garlic, crushed; 1 x (1 1/2 lb.) beef top round steak, thinly sliced; 1 bag (16 ounce.) frzn broccoli, red peppers, bamboo shoots and mushrooms, thawed Warm cooked MINUTE White Rice
directions: 1. Blend steak sauce, soy sauce and garlic in nonmetal dish. 2. Add in steak, stirring to coat. 3. Cover; chill 30 min, stirring occasionally. 4. Remove steak from marinade; reserve marinade. 5. Cook and stir steak in large, lightly greased skillet over medium-high heat for 3 to 4 min or possibly till meat is no longer pink. 6. Remove steak with slotted spoon; keep hot. 7. Heat vegetables and reserved marinade in same skillet to a boil; reduce heat. 8. Cover; simmer for 2 to 3 min. 9. Stir in beef. 10. Serve over warm cooked rice. 11. Special Extra: Add in 1/2 to 1 teaspoon warm pepper sauce with soy sauce.
